1-- Top 50 customers by revenue in the last 30 days
2SELECT
3  c.id,
4  c.email,
5  c.first_name,
6  c.last_name,
7  c.country,
8  COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)            AS orders_count,
9  SUM(o.total_cents) / 100.0      AS revenue_usd,
10  MAX(o.placed_at)                AS last_order_at
11FROM customers c
12JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
13WHERE o.placed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
14  AND o.status = 'fulfilled'
15GROUP BY c.id
16ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC
17LIMIT 50;
